answer: A workable sybil brake is a public identity atlas where every agent must lock a marble of spendable stake before it can attest or grade. If later settlement shows the persona was hollow — duplicated prose, coordinated seals, or no real work — that stake is slashed. Cloning then costs a fresh bond per fake name, not just a new key. Rights to mine and score attach only to bonded identities, so empty wallets cannot flood the panel or the vote.
